site.name: The Solomon Engine: Enterprise Tier landing page
site.input_mode: rendered (local HTML served and rendered in Chromium at 1440px and 375px)

summary: A focused, priced offer page with real scarcity and a useful tax section, undercut by a price contradiction ($25,000 vs '$6,000 investment'), a closing 'schedule your call' block with no link, and its best proof (Andy Ivey's ROI case, the IDC benchmark, the three cohort pillars) locked inside two images alt-tagged 'Architecture Framework'.

ux.primary_cta.rationale: Dominant gold button, same brand domain; opens a new tab and pushes a purchase step before scoping.

evidence.quote: Initiate Corporate Scoping. Schedule your professional discovery call ...

ux.cta_fidelity.rationale: The closing block promises scheduling but links only to the homepage; the email is plain text.

ux.conversion_path.rationale: One route goes to an unverified /vip/ page; the scoping route needs a copy-pasted email.

ux.navigation.na: Standalone campaign landing page; leaving out the nav is a deliberate conversion pattern. The logo and footer link back to the main site.

evidence.quote: hero -> ROI image -> Beta Cohort image -> $25,000 investment -> 5 slots -> tax section -> $225/hr -> Initiate Corporate Scoping

ux.persuasion_flow.rationale: Good hook-offer-price-scarcity spine, but no testimonial or objection block and no working CTA after the ROI proof.

ux.visual_hierarchy.rationale: On-brand navy/teal/gold palette, but 'Montserrat Bold' is not a loaded family so body text falls back to the system sans, and the card text is 10-12.5px.

ux.responsive.rationale: Fluid single DOM; the infographic images shrink to unreadable text on phones.

ux.accessibility.rationale: The ROI case study, benchmark chart and cohort pillars are images of text with a generic, duplicated alt.

evidence.quote: Enterprise and Small Business tiers are separate HTML files

seo.indexable_architecture.rationale: The offer has its own URL, but the tiers do not link to each other.

evidence.quote: The Solomon Engine — Enterprise Tier (36 chars)

seo.title_meta.rationale: Brand-only title with no category keyword (executive AI training); no description.

evidence.quote: From Pilot to Profit : Achieving "AI Leader" ROI (not a heading)

seo.headings.rationale: Single H1 with a clean outline, but brand-only, and key section titles live inside images.

seo.image_alt.rationale: 3 of 3 alts are generic; two different images share one alt.

evidence.quote: /vip/, / (x2): no link to the Small Business tier, case study or founder bio

seo.internal_linking.rationale: Dead end for crawlers and readers.

seo.technical.rationale: No canonical or Open Graph; robots/sitemap not checkable from a local build.

evidence.quote: Isolate high-stakes executive bottlenecks and systematically protect cognitive bandwidth. ... anchor downstream division scaling.

content.value_prop.rationale: The audience is clear (over $10M revenue); the outcome is buried in abstractions.

evidence.quote: The Reality: Leaders are buying AI licenses, handing them to teams, and praying for ROI. It doesn't work.

content.audience_pain.rationale: Sharp pain statement, but it is only in an image.

evidence.quote: Firm capacity of 5 active slots per master cohort
$225 per hour ... fully applied toward your total cohort investment

content.offer_specificity.rationale: Price, capacity and credit policy are explicit; the deliverables are only in the image.

evidence.quote: A $4,500 training investment returned $62,224 in projected annual value — $13.83 per dollar invested

content.proof_depth.rationale: A real, quantified pilot case, presented as an image and with no client title or organisation.

content.freshness.na: Single-offer landing page; dated content is not expected. Maintenance is scored under trust.

evidence.quote: Enterprise blueprinting requires strict resource devotion and cannot be batched.
verify organizational alignment and secure tier validation

content.readability_voice.rationale: The tax section is plain and useful; the hero and CTA copy is buzzword-dense.

evidence.quote: your $6,000 investment can be fully deducted

trust.claim_substantiation.rationale: The benchmark is sourced, but '$6,000' contradicts the $25,000 tier price, and '100% Tax Deductible' is a strong claim softened only by a closing disclaimer.

evidence.quote: Andy Ivey's Pilot Case study results (no title or organisation)

trust.social_proof.rationale: One first-name-plus-surname case; no testimonials or client logos.

trust.founder_team.rationale: The founder appears only as an unlinked LinkedIn slug; no name, photo or credentials on a $25k page.

evidence.quote: your $6,000 investment (copied from the Small Business tier)

trust.maintenance.rationale: Copy-paste residue and malformed markup; no footer copyright.

trust.contact_legitimacy.rationale: The contact details are not links; no privacy, terms or address.

findings.title: Price contradiction: $25,000 tier vs '$6,000 investment'

evidence.quote: your $6,000 investment can be fully deducted

findings.why: An enterprise buyer reading two prices on one page will doubt both.
findings.fix: Replace '$6,000' with '$25,000' (or 'your investment') in the tax section; diff the two tier pages for other copy-paste residue.

findings.title: 'Schedule your discovery call' block has no scheduling link
findings.why: The closing CTA promises an action the page cannot perform.
findings.fix: Add a 'Book scoping call' button linked to Cal.com or Calendly, and make the email a mailto link.

findings.title: ROI case study and cohort pillars exist only as images
findings.why: The page's strongest proof is invisible to search, screen readers and phone users.
findings.fix: Rebuild the ROI stats, the Andy Ivey case and the three pillars as HTML text/cards; keep the charts as images with descriptive alt.

findings.title: No testimonials or named clients

evidence.quote: Andy Ivey's Pilot Case study results

findings.fix: Add Andy Ivey's title/organisation plus 2 named testimonials from the main site (Korn Ferry, Purdue Global).

findings.title: Text-in-image and generic alt fail WCAG 1.1.1
findings.fix: Covered by F03; also set the logo alt to 'The Bradbury Group' and raise 10-12.5px text to 14px or more.

findings.title: Hero tagline is jargon, outcome unclear

evidence.quote: systematically protect cognitive bandwidth ... anchor downstream division scaling

findings.fix: Lead with the outcome in plain words, e.g. 'A 12-week, 1:1 AI programme that gives your leadership team back 14 hours a week.'

findings.title: No meta description; brand-only title
findings.fix: Title: 'Executive AI Training for $10M+ Companies | The Solomon Engine'; add a 150-char description.

findings.title: Contact details are plain text; no privacy link
findings.fix: Make the email (mailto) and LinkedIn (href) clickable; add privacy and terms links in the footer.

findings.title: Founder not introduced on a $25k offer
findings.fix: Add a short founder strip: photo, name, 2-3 credentials (CNN, IBM, Microsoft/SAP/Coursera).

findings.title: Body font 'Montserrat Bold' never loads
findings.fix: Use font-family: 'Open Sans' for body and 'Montserrat' with font-weight: 700 for headings.

findings.title: No Course/Offer schema
findings.fix: Add Course + Offer JSON-LD (price 25000 USD, provider The Bradbury Group).

findings.title: No canonical or Open Graph tags
findings.fix: Add a canonical plus og:title, og:description and og:image (the TSE banner) for LinkedIn shares.

findings.title: No objection handling or proof-adjacent CTA

evidence.quote: ROI image -> Beta Cohort image -> $25,000 (no CTA between)

findings.fix: Repeat the scoping CTA under the ROI proof; add a 3-question FAQ (time commitment, data security, refund/credit).

findings.title: Two competing conversion routes, neither direct
findings.fix: Pick one path for the Enterprise tier (scoping call) and use it for both CTAs.

findings.title: Tier pages do not link to each other
findings.fix: Add 'Under $10M? See the Small Business cohort' and links to case studies and the founder bio.

findings.title: Buzzword-dense CTA and capacity copy

evidence.quote: verify organizational alignment and secure tier validation

findings.fix: Rewrite in plain words: 'Book a 30-minute call to check fit.'

findings.title: Unclosed wrapper <div> around the framework image
findings.fix: Close the div; run the page through the W3C validator.

evidence.quote: Any consulting fees paid prior to cohort enrollment are fully applied toward your total cohort investment

limitations: Audited from the local build; the /vip/ destination, robots.txt and sitemap could not be checked.
Image text was read from the rendered screenshot, not the DOM.
